id: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian (2008)

facts.text: Serve the snacks when the Pevensies find the apple trees at the ruins of Cair Paravel.
facts.why: A script copy has Lucy finding a single apple among the ruins and eating it, not apple trees.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when Lucy finds an apple among the ruins of Cair Paravel.

vibe.verdict: Reepicheep's real line, the trees, the duel and the night raid now print on a decent army camp card, but the food is still generic camp fare.
missing: The White Witch in the ice wall
ideas: Swap 'Telmarine fennel roast pork loin' note ('Miraz's Telmarine castle') for the night raid on the castle.
Swap 'Reepicheep's cheddar and chive scones' note for the tail growing back.
Swap 'Cair Paravel apples' note for Lucy's cordial.
Add a Strand station ticket to the cover.
iconic: Reepicheep: I didn't say I'd let you live
changed: Camp labels renamed (mains, drinks, note, call)
